frontmatter.title: Identity and sign-in.
frontmatter.lead: Identity is a capability like any other. You get a stable, opaque handle for the signed-in user — never a token, never an email, never a secret.

frontmatter.title: The consent model.
frontmatter.lead: Access to data is asked for, not taken. The filesystem you see is the filesystem you got. Every privileged call replies with a typed result, and forbidden means policy — not a bug to retry around.

frontmatter.title: The SDK entry point.
frontmatter.lead: All platform interaction goes through @immediately-run/sdk — the only channel between your sandboxed app and the host. Pin it, import it, and call protocol methods reactively.

frontmatter.title: Run any app from its source.
frontmatter.lead: immediately.run loads a React + TypeScript app straight from a GitHub repo and transpiles it in the browser — no server, no deploy step. Open it, use it, then pop the hood.

frontmatter.title: Give a fork a folder to work in.
frontmatter.outcome: A forked app bound to a folder it can read and write, by your consent.
frontmatter.prereqs: A fork of an app and a space or folder to bind it to.
